title: Stilled Hearts | ECHO//100 Episode 21
description: Kavi watches in horror as the city's frozen population loses their own shadows to a dark, autonomous existence. Episode 21 of ECHO//100: The City Without Shadows. AI-assisted original fiction.

scenes.text: The city clock halts, leaving citizens frozen like statues beneath a blood-red sky.
scenes.caption: Frozen city square
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical wide shot of Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses standing in a city square filled with people frozen mid-step, sky is deep ominous red.

scenes.text: Shadows peel away from the pavement, moving with a life of their own.
scenes.caption: Shadows detaching
scenes.image_prompt: Close up on the ground where a man's shadow detaches from his feet, rising into a 3D silhouette shape.

scenes.text: Kavi watches the scanner fail as silhouettes manifest like stolen memories seeking freedom.
scenes.caption: Byte scans shadows
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at his floating companion Byte, whose cyan face glows as it scans a shadow walking past them.

scenes.text: Mira touches a drifting shadow and gasps, experiencing a lifetime of alien secrets.
scenes.caption: Mira feels the memory
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her blue holographic coat reaching out to touch a passing dark silhouette, her eyes widening in realization.

scenes.text: The Null-glitch in Kavi’s chest pulses, attempting to reclaim the fragments torn apart.
scenes.caption: Kavi's internal struggle
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi clutching his backpack straps, black and purple glitch energy leaking from his chest near his red hoodie.

scenes.text: Kavi evicted the collective trauma, casting those dark memories to wander the streets.
scenes.caption: The tragic reversal
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at the Red Door shards on the ground, realizing the shadows are the city's discarded past.

scenes.text: The populace remains catatonic while their histories march toward the edge of town.
scenes.caption: Empty citizens
scenes.image_prompt: View of the square where citizens stand like mannequins while their shadows march away in a unified pack.

scenes.text: Kavi’s own shadow stands tall, turns, and stares with burning, impossible, glowing red eyes.
scenes.caption: The shadow rebels
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking down at his own shadow on the floor, which has turned to look up at him with glowing red eyes.
